definition: The task of automatically translating text from one natural language into another.
details: Machine translation was one of the earliest and most impactful applications of neural sequence-to-sequence models, and the encoder-decoder attention mechanisms developed for translation directly inspired the transformer architecture.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Boil it down and it is this: The task of automatically translating text from one natural language into another. Here is why it matters: Machine translation was one of the earliest and most impactful applications of neural sequence-to-sequence models, and the encoder-decoder attention mechanisms developed for translation directly inspired the transformer architecture. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Machine Translation.
